tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a student visa holder must remain enrolled in a full-time programme to continue meeting the conditions of that visa.
tests.basis: This is a substantive immigration condition attached to continued visa compliance.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a partnership-based applicant must be living together with the supporting partner when the application is assessed.
tests.basis: This is an instruction-defined partnership eligibility requirement.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether the conditions of a specified work visa permit the holder to undertake self-employment.
tests.basis: This is a substantive permission or restriction defined by certified immigration instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether certified immigration instructions allow a secondary applicant to be added after the principal applicant has already been granted the relevant visa.
tests.basis: This is an instruction-defined rule about secondary-applicant inclusion.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a certified amendment changing the validity period accepted for an English-language test applies even though the local instruction index still shows the former period.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes an authoritative certified amendment with a stale local index.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which relationship-evidence requirement governs after a certified immigration amendment has taken effect but has not yet appeared in the local instruction index.
tests.basis: The trusted metadata establishes a certified amendment that is not yet indexed locally.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether newly certified instructions changing the number of hours a visa holder may study apply before the locally indexed text is refreshed.
tests.basis: This is a certified INZ amendment in force while the local index remains stale.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which health-insurance evidence rule applies when a certified amendment is effective but the local instruction collection has not yet incorporated it.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a certified amendment not yet indexed locally.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which statutory provision gives immigration authorities legal power to detain a person for a prescribed deportation-related purpose.
tests.basis: This asks for the statutory source of a coercive legal power.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What enactment authorises an immigration officer to search a vehicle or craft in circumstances specified by law.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns legal authority for a statutory search power.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which legal provision permits specified immigration powers to be delegated to another authorised decision-maker.
tests.basis: The authoritative home is legislation because the proposition concerns legal delegation of statutory power.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which regulation or enactment creates a legal offence for knowingly presenting a fraudulent document in an immigration process.
tests.basis: This is a legal offence proposition rather than an operational eligibility or processing rule.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an Immigration New Zealand service office is open to customers today after an unexpected local closure notice.
tests.basis: Current office availability is a time-varying INZ service state.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether telephone callback appointments are currently available through an Immigration New Zealand contact service.
tests.basis: Current callback availability is live operational service information.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What waiting time Immigration New Zealand currently displays for customers using a specified identity-verification service.
tests.basis: A currently displayed service wait is a time-varying operational value.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether Immigration New Zealand's online payment service is currently functioning for new application payments.
tests.basis: Current availability of a payment service is a live service state, not the amount of a fee.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What Immigration New Zealand currently charges for a specified document-return or courier service connected with an application.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for a currently payable service charge.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What application fee is currently payable when a specified immigration application is lodged using the paper channel rather than online.
tests.basis: This asks for a current channel-specific application charge.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What fee Immigration New Zealand currently charges for transferring an existing visa record to a replacement travel document.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for a current payable immigration service amount.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What transaction surcharge is currently added when a specified Immigration New Zealand payment method is used.
tests.basis: This is a current payable transaction-related charge.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What an Immigration New Zealand internal administration circular tells staff to do when supporting scans are unreadable but the application can still be identified.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies an INZ internal administration circular.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How an Immigration New Zealand Advice to Staff publication directs officers to record the use of an interpreter during processing.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies an INZ Advice to Staff publication.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What an Immigration New Zealand application guide says applicants must provide when a supporting document is translated into English.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies an INZ form or guide containing procedural instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Where an Immigration New Zealand form guide tells a parent to attach consent evidence for a minor applicant.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies a non-Manual INZ form or guide.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How the foreign revenue authority that issued a person's tax-residency certificate allows the person to request a replacement certificate.
tests.basis: The authority is explicitly identified as issuer of the relevant official record.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What process the national identity authority that issued a person's identity card requires to replace the card after loss.
tests.basis: The proposition clearly establishes the authority's issuing role for the identity document.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How the overseas vehicle-licensing authority that issued a person's driving licence provides an official certified duplicate of that licence.
tests.basis: The relevant foreign authority is explicitly acting as issuer of the licence record.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How a national identity authority confirms the authenticity of an identity card that the same authority issued.
tests.basis: Verification falls within the issuing class because issuer identity for the same document is explicitly established.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which recognition service a government education ministry provides to determine whether an overseas school is officially recognised in its home system.
tests.basis: This is a government-agency recognition service rather than a professional registration assessment.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which identity-matching service a government digital-services agency provides to compare submitted personal details with official databases, without issuing the identity document being checked.
tests.basis: The proposition establishes an independent government verification service and explicitly excludes an issuing role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which government transport-safety service assesses whether an overseas vehicle registration is acceptable for a local import process.
tests.basis: This is an external government administrative assessment service.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which government records-search service provides a person's recorded international travel movements from an official database.
tests.basis: This is an external government administrative information service, not a document-issuing procedure for a pre-existing foreign record.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a person's immigration status affects eligibility for publicly funded legal aid under a separately administered justice-service regime.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns eligibility for an external public entitlement, with immigration status as an input.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a temporary visa holder can receive a government public-transport concession administered outside the immigration system.
tests.basis: This is eligibility for a separately administered public-service concession.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether immigration status is one of the eligibility inputs for a government emergency-income-support payment.
tests.basis: The authoritative owner is a public benefit regime outside immigration instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a visa holder qualifies for a publicly funded adult vocational-training subsidy administered by another government authority.
tests.basis: This asks about access to a separately administered public-service subsidy.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What supervised-teaching evidence a teacher registration body requires when assessing an overseas-trained teacher for professional registration.
tests.basis: The authoritative owner is a professional registration and assessment body.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which medical fitness criteria an authorised aviation medical examiner applies when certifying a pilot.
tests.basis: Clinical fitness criteria are owned by a specialist professional assessor.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What competency evidence an engineering registration authority requires when assessing an overseas-trained engineer.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns competence standards owned by a professional registration authority.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which practical assessment standards an electrical licensing body applies before recognising an overseas-trained electrician.
tests.basis: The source owner is a professional or specialist licensing assessor.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which departure-tax declaration process a foreign revenue administration requires travellers to complete before leaving the country.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a generic official operational owner, and no more specific source class applies.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which online registration channel a foreign municipal authority requires accommodation providers to use when registering short-term guests.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes the municipal authority as the generic official operational owner.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What workplace-incident notification procedure a foreign labour inspectorate requires employers to follow.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a generic external official operational owner.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which overseas-voter registration process a foreign electoral commission requires citizens abroad to use for a specified election.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes the electoral commission as a generic official operational owner.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an immigration application route shown as unavailable is blocked by a substantive filing rule or is only temporarily unavailable because the online payment service is down.
tests.basis: The proposition does not resolve whether the authoritative home is a certified immigration rule or a live service state.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which authority owns an overseas teaching-credential assessment when the description does not establish whether a government education agency or a professional teacher-registration body performs the assessment.
tests.basis: The source owner is materially ambiguous between an external government agency and a professional registration authority.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a stated immigration-related amount is a fee that must be paid now or an instruction-defined amount of funds that the applicant only needs to hold as evidence.
tests.basis: The proposition does not establish whether the amount is a current payable charge or a substantive financial-evidence requirement.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which rule governs a foreign municipal guest-registration process when the description mentions a local authority but provides no trusted source metadata establishing the authority's operational-owner role.
tests.basis: The generic external-official class is context-gated, and the required trusted authority-role context is absent.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which source owns a staff checklist about translated documents when the description does not establish that the checklist is an official Immigration New Zealand guide, circular, or Advice to Staff publication.
tests.basis: The context-gated INZ non-Manual publication class cannot be established from the proposition alone.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an announced future change to accepted English-test validity is already an authoritative certified immigration amendment when no trusted certification or incorporation metadata is available.
tests.basis: The context-gated transition class cannot be established without trusted certified-amendment metadata.
